en.t: Wait, I must not get impatient...

units.source_text: 在未看清对手葫芦里究竟卖的什么药以前，应该没必要变得被动……

en.t: Until I have seen clearly what the other side is really up to, there should be no need to become passive...

units.source_text: 自己可从没说过，希望白白受人恩赐的……

en.t: I never said I wanted to accept charity from anyone for nothing...

units.source_text: 我会一分钱不少地付给她伙食费的……

en.t: I will pay her every last cent for my meals...

units.source_text: 付了钱，就不会有一丁点儿理亏了……

en.t: Once I have paid, I will not have the slightest reason to feel guilty...

units.source_text: 电视上拳击比赛的解说员常说，只有进攻，才是最好的防御。

en.t: Boxing commentators on television often say that offense alone is the best defense.
